goals: Verify the client-side application's initial setup, including HTML structure and authentication configuration.
Verify the server correctly serves the main application pages.
activities: Load the 'supertest' module.
Load the 'path' module.
Load the 'fs' module.
Load the application from 'server.js'.
Disable Jest's mocking for the 'fs' module.
Read the 'App/index.html' file content.
Set the global document's HTML content using the read 'index.html'.
Locate the HTML element with ID 'load-msal'.
Get the 'src' attribute value of the 'load-msal' element.
Assert that the 'src' attribute contains 'https://alcdn.msauth.net/browser'.
Load the MSAL configuration object from 'authConfig.js'.
Assert that the MSAL configuration object is defined.
Define a regular expression for a GUID format.
Assert that the MSAL client ID matches the GUID format.
Define a regular expression for a URI format.
Assert that the MSAL authority URI matches the URI format.
Set the Node.js environment variable 'NODE_ENV' to 'test'.
Send a GET request to the application's root path ('/').
Read the 'App/index.html' file content from the file system for comparison.
Assert that the HTTP response status code for the root path request is 200.
Assert that the HTTP response body for the root path request matches the 'index.html' file content.
Send a GET request to the application's '/signout' path.
Read the 'App/signout.html' file content from the file system for comparison.
Assert that the HTTP response status code for the '/signout' request is 200.
Assert that the HTTP response body for the '/signout' request matches the 'signout.html' file content.
